messages:
maria: Heads-up: incoming pentest intake for the KV-cache feature in staging. Assessors asked to run live probes. We need to lock down evidence paths and short-lived access. Proposed window: 2024-04-04 14:00-16:00 UTC.

 tim: Sounds good. Two quick asks: (1) ephemeral role duration min 2h, (2) dedicated KMS key for exports to avoid mixing logs.

 sasha: +1 for dedicated key. Draft approach: create KMS key scoped to assessors, allow kms:GenerateDataKey & kms:Decrypt, and restrict use to the assessor role via Condition "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/assessor-role"}. Uploads to a separate evidence-bucket with forced object prefix.

 andre: Ops can provision an ephemeral STS role for assessors. We'll set MaxSessionDuration=7200. Need assessor OIDC subjects or federated role ARNs to lock trust policy. Also will ensure egress rules allow uploads to S3 endpoint.

 zoe: Audit side: enable CloudTrail data events for S3 and KMS, preserve logs off-cluster to gs://pt-audit-archive/ with 120d retention. Evidence uploads must include a checksum manifest and manifest must be written to a write-once prefix. We'll run a snapshot of logs 15m into the window and again at close.

 maria: Can someone paste a minimal KMS key policy and an S3 bucket policy example so we can review? Also need a short runbook for assessors on filename conventions and presigned url flow.

 sasha: KMS key policy (draft):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAssessorUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/assessor-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/assessor-role"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Note: we can tighten Resource to the key ARN before applying.

 andre: S3 bucket policy snippet for evidence-bucket: allow PutObject only from the assessor role and from our CI account; reject PutObject without the x-amz-meta-pt-ticket header. I'll post the full policy in docs.

 tim: I'll take retest verification. Plan: after fixes land, we'll attempt the original PoC against a canary, gather log exports, verify checksum/manifest, and mark the JIRA PT-4567 as verified. Include remediation PR URLs in the ticket.

 ops-bot: infra-action: create-ephemeral-role assessor-pt-1708801234 scheduled

 zoe: Evidence naming convention proposal: pt-4567_assessor-<id>_20240404T1400Z.bin and pt-4567_manifest.json. Include sha256 in manifest and upload manifest first then data. We'll checksum server-side and fail if mismatch.

 sasha: Also recommend presigned upload flow: ops generates presigned PUT with 1h expiry; assessor uploads to the evidence-bucket/prefix and then issues a confirmation message with object key + sha256. We'll automate verification via a lambda that moves validated objects into archive and writes an audit record to SIEM.

 andre: Creating the role now. ETA 45m. I'll post the role ARN + presigned URL generation steps when ready. Also validating bucket policy to enforce uploads only from role principal.

 maria: Thanks. Action items recap: Andre to create role + bucket policy; Sasha to finalize KMS policy; Ops to publish presigned URL runbook; Zoe to configure audit snapshots and retention; Tim to be retest owner and list verification checklist in JIRA PT-4567.

 tim: Quick checklist I'll add to the ticket: reproduce exploit, capture canary traces, confirm logs include required events, validate S3 object checksum & manifest, run smoke tests, and sign off.

 maria: Great. I'll open PT-4567 and assign tasks. Please paste any policy snippets or links here once done. :thumbsup:
